name: Plugin Card Widget
description: Draggable/resizable card widget. DOM card with header (canvas-rendered title via @chenglou/pretext), close button (hover-reveal), body, edge resize handles (east/south/southeast). Drag by header (snaps to 28px grid). Resize with minimum snap. UUID via crypto.randomUUID().

interface.constructor: constructor(id: string, title: string, container: HTMLElement)
methods: getState(): { id: string, title: string, x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number }
